deviceSessions.title: Devices & sessions
deviceSessions.confirmRevokeOthersTitle: Sign out of all other devices?
deviceSessions.confirmRevokeOthersBody: This will sign out {{count}} other session(s) across {{deviceCount}} other device(s). Your current device stays signed in.
deviceSessions.confirmRevokeDeviceBody: This will end {{count}} session(s) on this device and stop it from receiving notifications.
deviceSessions.confirmRevokeCurrentDeviceBody: This removes the device you're using right now, so you'll be signed out here too.
deviceSessions.loadError: Unable to load your devices and sessions. Try reloading the page.

accountDeletion.title: Delete account
accountDeletion.description: Permanently delete your Studafy account and your personal data.
accountDeletion.heading: Delete your account
accountDeletion.pending: A deletion request is already in progress (filed {{date}}). We'll process it within 30 days.
accountDeletion.consequenceSignOut: Sign you out on every device straight away and remove your access to your school.
accountDeletion.consequenceProfile: Erase your name, contact details and profile from Studafy within 30 days.
accountDeletion.consequenceBilling: Cancel any AI subscription so it doesn't renew.
accountDeletion.consequenceRetained: Keep only what your school must legally retain: your grades and attendance (without your name or contact details), plus financial and audit records.
accountDeletion.previousFailed: Your last deletion request couldn't be completed. Please try again or contact your school.
accountDeletion.confirmBody: You'll be signed out everywhere right away. This can't be undone.
accountDeletion.completedBody: You've been signed out on every device. Your personal data will be erased by {{date}}.
accountDeletion.completedRetainedIntro: Your school keeps only these records, as the law requires:

retained.academic_grades: Grades, without your name or contact details
retained.attendance: Attendance, without your name or contact details
retained.audit_log: Security and audit log entries, including the record of this deletion
